rationale: Legal/business news wire is a recurring signal producer but access status unknown (largely subscription) and only indirectly on-scope.
Single ZJN-3A amendment page on pisrs.si; covered by monitoring the PISRS register entry for ZJN-3.
Another static ZJN-3 amendment page on the same PISRS register already covered by the parent.
Consolidated NPB view of ZJN-3 is the practical reading surface but sits inside the PISRS parent registry.
ZDIJZ statute page is the legal hook for obtaining banking/payments contracts; monitored via the PISRS register parent.
Searchable IPRS FOI decision database continuously yields named obliged bodies and disclosed contract detail.
Regulator guidance section of ip-rs.si; useful context but a sub-page of the covered parent domain.
One-off PDF practice digest: valuable reference on what contract data is disclosable, not a recurring feed.
Statutory national procurement notice portal and archive — the core A2 source for Slovenia.
Ministry's recurring statistical report series on awarded contracts and below-threshold visibility bands.
Machine-readable OPSI dataset of live e-JN procurements; cheapest structured monitoring entry point.
Erar exposes transaction-level public payments to banks and payment vendors, including contracts with no award notice.
KPK publishes recurring procurement-integrity analyses and the data caveats needed to read Erar correctly.
DKOM review decisions continuously reveal bidders, specs and evaluation detail for contested financial-services lots.
Court of Audit report archive regularly reproduces contract values and counterparties for IT and financial procurements.
TI Slovenia research programme is a standing producer of procurement-integrity analysis and FOI cases.
Static FOI catalogue of Banka Slovenije: mine once for information categories and the FOI request route.
AJPES business register is the standing resolver of award-notice supplier names to legal entities and ownership.
TED carries above-threshold Slovenian awards with structured eForms and bulk XML — archive of record in English.
Official gazette of record for ZJN-3/ZDIJZ texts and effective dates; authoritative fallback, publishes continuously.
Case-law database producing ongoing judicial rulings on FOI and procurement disputes involving banks.
Full-text DKOM search is a distinct retrieval surface enabling banking/payments-scoped queries across all decisions.
DKOM annual work reports live under the same dkom.si parent already monitored for decisions.
